notes.title: Dynamic Game Update!
notes.content:
[b]Slide Kick[/b] Now you can make a Slide Kick on the ground while you running, slide kick is a very powerful ability and it consumes energy, play the tutorial section to learn how to do it.
[b]Run[/b] mechanic has been implemented as well!
[b]Energy bar[/b] - affecting Run mechanic and Slide Kick, Please play the Tutorial section of the game to learn a little bit more about new mechanics!
[b]Bug fixes [/b]- many bugs have been fixed, so the gameplay process now going smooth and better!
[b]Enemy AI[/b] - Hulk's become a little bit smarter, and also stopped attacking when getting hurt!
[b]Slow Mo[/b] - Now whenever an enemy or Player registers a physical hit, time in the game freezes for 0.1sec to make the gameplay process a little bit clear so you can see whose got hurt and also gives you a short time frame to think about your next step.

So enjoy this Update!
Thank you for Playing Dictator's Creed!
